Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing the industrial insurance system administered by the department of labor and industries.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to addressing the industrial insurance systemadministered by the department of labor and industries; and creating anew section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the Washingtonindustrial insurance system administered by the department of labor andindustries is being affected by a period of national and state economicuncertainty that has reduced investment income and increased stresseson the system. It is the intent of the legislature to address theseshortterm economic problems with policy changes that assist thisindustrial insurance system through this period of uncertainty and thatmeet all of the following goals: (1) The policy changes should treat workers fairly withoutaffecting their longstanding rights under the system; (2) The policy changes should support a sound and stable financialbasis for the system; and (3) The policy changes should allow immediate efficiencies in p. 1 HB 2158administration.
